competition.name: V5 Override
competition.scope: two abstract quadrant stack interfaces, not the central midfield goal

evidence.selection: Observed goal-choice family; target envelopes use its upper score quartile, not a causal minimum search

capabilityRequirements.minimumScope: Geometric reach and possession requirements of the representative simulated sequence only
capabilityRequirements.targetBasis: One observed feasible capability sample; no independent mixing of marginal best features

tradeoffs: Drive, handling and reach share the sampled abstract budget; hardware feasibility remains unverified
Yellow-half scores depend on retaining toggle ownership at the episode end
Cup preparation costs time without immediate points, but enables another Pin placement
Midfield positioning trades remaining scoring time against eight modeled terminal points
limitations: Not real robot or match performance
Assumed positions, reach heights and action dynamics
One visible scoring half per Pin, with idealized Cup orientation
No validated CAD geometry or mechanism capability
